name: Spear Gleam
description: Throw a gleam shaped like a short spear that pricks the target and lights the spot for a breath.

name: Lance Step
description: Lunge a long pace forward along a line of light with the lead hand held out like a point.

name: Edge Glint
description: Flick the wrist so a glinting edge of light turns a thrust off its line.

name: Lance Sense
description: Point a thin beam ahead and feel through it the distance and shape of whatever it touches.

name: Hot Needle
description: Push a needle of white heat through a seam in the guard to burn a single joint.

name: Shaft Draw
description: Draw the light slowly into one straight shaft along the arm so the next thrust carries its whole weight.

name: Pierce Flash
description: Pierce the guard hand with a hard flash so the grip fails and the guard drops open.

name: Searing Shaft
description: Drive one shaft of white heat through a raised guard and the arm behind it in a single thrust of will.

name: Lance Shower
description: Rain a dozen small lances of light onto a wide patch so that none who stand there escape a hit.

name: Ward Glow
description: Set a steady glow round an ally that blunts blows and keeps its brightness while held.

name: Ward Touch
description: Rest a glowing hand on an ally's side and warm a cracked rib back toward the whole.

name: Shed Flash
description: Flash across the ward so a stray blow slips off the glow and away from the wounded.

name: Steady Lamp
description: Hold a lamp of even light over an ally's chest so their breath settles and their nerve returns.

name: Lamp Cleanse
description: Pass the lamp along a poisoned limb and burn the taint out of the ally's blood.

name: Ward Lattice
description: Weave the glow into a lattice of light bars that stops blows aimed at the wounded.

name: Lamp Mantle
description: Wrap a wounded ally in a mantle of warm light that turns blows and mends flesh while it holds.

name: Breath Rekindle
description: Pour light through the chest of one whose breath has just stopped to call it back within a short window; it never returns the long dead.

name: Halo Lumen
description: Let a faint field of glow follow the body and thin out the force of weak blows.

name: Wide Ray
description: Throw a wide ray that spreads as it goes and stings anyone caught in its cone.

name: Halo Gleam
description: Let the field gleam outward and feel each body that crosses its edge.

name: Reach Pace
description: Throw the field ahead and step into the far end of it in one stride.

name: Wide Flash
description: Burst the field outward in one white flash that blinds those who face it.

name: Halo Throb
description: Beat the field in slow pulses that burn and shove everyone inside it back from the user.

name: Broad Sheen
description: Draw the field in to a broad sheen on the front that stops arrows and thrown stones.

name: Halo Survey
description: Read the weight and pace of each figure inside the field by how it bends the light.

name: Radiant Halo
description: Spread the qi field as a blazing plain of light that burns the foes inside it and weighs down their qi.

name: Lumen Tide
description: Send the whole field out in one wave of light that sweeps across the ground and throws back all in its path.

name: Mark Glint
description: Set a small glint on the target's chest so the next strike finds that exact spot.

name: Measured Ray
description: Loose a ray of exact length that stops at the target and never overshoots.

name: Dawn Palm
description: Strike with an open palm that carries a pale hot glow and leaves a mark where it lands.

name: Formal Guard
description: Hold a formal square guard of light before the body with the elbows tight.

name: Exact Beam
description: Fire a beam along the mark and strike the marked point without touching anything near it.

name: Mark Stride
description: Stride along the line of a mark and arrive within a hand's width of the target.

name: Dawn Seal
description: Press a disc of pale light onto the target's chest to cut off the flow of their qi for a time.

name: Reckoning Stroke
description: Drive a fist full of light into the marked point so the blow bores through to the bone.

name: Marked Fall
description: Call down a column of light onto the marked point so that it falls exactly there and nowhere else.

name: Prism Mote
description: Flick a mote of light that splits into three stinging beads in flight.

name: Colour Flash
description: Flash a bright pattern of colour before the eyes so the target loses the line of the blow.

name: Facet Screen
description: Hold a faceted screen of light before the body to turn a missile onto a new line.

name: Beam Sight
description: Follow a thin beam to its end and sense the body that stopped it.

name: Split Lattice
description: Break one beam into a lattice of thin beams that crosses the whole front of the user.

name: Rejoin Beam
description: Bring the split beams back together on one spot so they strike with the weight of a single lance.

name: Prism Sphere
description: Raise a sphere of crossing beams round a target and close them in from every side at once.

name: Facet Crown
description: Set a crown of turning facets round the body that breaks heavy blows into harmless scatter.

name: Truth Gleam
description: Let a plain gleam fall on a person and note where the qi in them is held.

name: Clear Flash
description: Flash a plain bright pulse at a caster's hands to break the rhythm of their working.

name: Lucid Palm
description: Strike with a palm of clear light that leaves a faint white burn.

name: Lucid Step
description: Step along a lit line to land exactly where the light shows the foe will be.

name: Unmask Ray
description: Burn a masking shroud of qi off the target so that their true form is plain to all.

name: Qi Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of light before a figure and read the strength of their qi in its reflection.

name: Pure Beam
description: Fire a beam so pure that it passes through false glimmers and strikes only the real body.

name: Revealing Light
description: Pour light across a wide area so every concealed thing in it is shown and every hidden foe is slowed.

name: Burn Away
description: Pass a wave of clean light over an ally to burn away a curse or a binding laid on them.

name: Long Gleam
description: Throw a long thin gleam that keeps its sting over a great reach.

name: Wide Stride
description: Take a very long stride on a bar of light to cross open ground in a breath.

name: Reach Glow
description: Send a glow far out and feel any body that breaks it.

name: Broad Guard
description: Hold the arms wide behind a broad bright shield that keeps its shape on open ground.

name: Beam Lash
description: Snap a whip of light from the hand and cut it across the target's guard arm.

name: Long Beam
description: Hold a thin beam on the target while walking forward so it bores a little deeper at every pace.

name: Stride Surge
description: Surge forward two long strides on a wave of light with the guard still ready.

name: Reach Mend
description: Send a mending beam across a gap to an ally's wound and hold it there until the bleeding slows.

name: Reaching Beam
description: Hold a great beam on a far target and widen it step by step until it bores through any guard.

name: Stride Volley
description: Cross the field in one long stride and loose a volley of beams from the new footing.

name: Sight Gleam
description: Open the eyes wide to a soft gleam that makes dim shapes plain.

name: Unhidden Ray
description: Throw a straight ray in plain view of the foe so that the honest strike lands first.

name: Oath Guard
description: Raise an open guard of light with the palm forward as the oath is spoken.

name: Clear Step
description: Step forward into the light with nothing held back and nothing hidden.

name: Seeking Glare
description: Hold a glare on the one who hides and weigh down their qi until they must step out.

name: Expose Flash
description: Flash into a shadowed corner to break any cover and cancel a concealing technique there.

name: Allsight
description: Fill the field with light and feel every body in it whether it is seen or hidden.

name: Sworn Blaze
description: Raise the field to one great blaze of open light that sears all in front of the oath-taker.

name: Clean Glow
description: Lay a clean glow on an ally's burns and cuts to cool them and close the surface.

name: Pure Touch
description: Touch a foe with a hand of white light that stings and numbs the spot.

name: Bright Slide
description: Slide a pace along a smooth band of light to put the wounded behind the user.

name: Luster Screen
description: Hold a screen of polished light before a healer at work so the patient is not struck.

name: Blood Wash
description: Wash an ally's blood in a clean pale light that burns out poison carried in the veins.

name: Fever Purge
description: Break the fever of a taint with one hard pulse of cold light through the ally's chest.

name: Luster Flow
description: Let a slow flow of bright light run through a broken limb and ease the bone back toward its place.

name: Radiant Purge
description: Fill the field with clean light that burns taint and curse from every ally standing in it.

name: Heartlight Return
description: Drive a surge of warm light into one whose heart has just stopped to restart it within a short window.
